title: What the Axolotl keeps

is_this_you.pressure: Corner you and you do not fight. You change shape, slip off into the water, and surface later looking unbothered.
is_this_you.love: You show up soft, gills out, and you stay with whoever never asks you to grow up on schedule.
is_this_you.cost: Everyone keeps waiting for you to change. Some years you wonder too whether you are staying or hiding.

opener.text: In the Florentine Codex, the Fifth Sun would not move until the gods gave up their lives to push it [s7]. Xolotl said no [s7] [s8]. He ran, and he changed shape three times to hide: a maize plant with two stalks, a doubled maguey, and last of all an axolotl in the water [s7] [s8]. You were born an Aquarius in a Rabbit year. You have turned down an ending or two yourself.

howto: Three parts. Swim through them in any order.

tabs.label: Staying young
tabs.intro: Fixed Air, yin Wood, and a body that never bothered to finish.

rows.text: Aquarius is fixed Air, ruled by Saturn and in modern astrology by Uranus [s1]. It is independent and unconventional, and it keeps to its own course [s1] [s2]. The Rabbit is yin Wood, faithful, patient and kind [s3] [s4]. It also slips out of reality when reality gets loud [s4]. In you the two make a sweet, odd stubbornness. You will not change for anyone, and you will be very nice about it.

The axolotl reaches adulthood and breeds while keeping its larval body, feathery gills included [s6]. Scientists call this neoteny [s6]. It also has lungs and gulps air at the surface [s6]. You kept the young shape too, the open face and the odd questions. It works fine for a grown-up life.
Rehab, lab research, wetland restoration and strange original design all suit you. Pick work where starting over is part of the job.

tabs.label: What grows back
tabs.intro: Lose a piece. Grow a working one.

rows.text: An axolotl can regrow a lost limb, and parts of its heart, brain and spinal cord, without a scar [s6]. The gift fades with age but never fully goes [s6] [s13]. Your losses heal like that. Months later something new fills the gap, and it works.

Aquarius can turn cool and far away [s1]. The Rabbit runs from what hurts [s4]. Together you can sit calmly at the bottom of the canal while the lake drains around you. Look up now and then. Check the water level.

tabs.label: Who keeps you as you are
tabs.intro: Three who like your shape. One who wants it changed.
tabs.love_lead: In love you arrive soft and exposed. You need someone who will not ask for a new form. Once settled, the Rabbit is faithful [s3]. Three old pairings leave you as you came.

easy.why: The Luna Moth (Libra, Goat year) shares your trine of Rabbit, Goat and Pig, and Libra is Air like Aquarius [s5] [s1].
The Cacomistle (Gemini, Pig year) completes the trine, Gemini is Air, and the Pig's Water feeds your Rabbit's Wood [s5] [s1].
The Duetting Frog (Libra, Dog year) is your secret friend, since the Dog is the Rabbit's six-harmony partner, and Libra is Air too [s5] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Sunset Moth (Leo, Rooster year): the Rooster clashes with the Rabbit, and Leo sits opposite Aquarius [s5] [s1].

story.text: Mexico's 50-peso note, issued in 2021, shows an axolotl swimming in the Xochimilco canals [s11]. In April 2022 the International Bank Note Society named it Bank Note of the Year [s11]. A god's last hiding place is now pocket money.

closing: Lose what you must. Grow it back your way, gills and all.
